summarize_COCOEvalWrapper: summarize the COCOEvalWrapper class that extends COCOeval to compute and display COCO evaluation summary metrics
run_COCOEvalWrapper_summarize: run the COCOEvalWrapper summarize method to compute AP and AR stats across IoU thresholds and area ranges
